name: mail-mock
description: SMTP relay with STARTTLS and AUTH, and an IMAP mailbox where caught mail is read back by Message-ID.

settings.name: refuse_recipient
settings.description: Comma-separated recipient addresses answered 550 at RCPT TO; empty refuses none.

settings.name: auth_required
settings.description: When true, MAIL FROM before a successful AUTH is answered 530.

settings.name: smtp_delay_ms
settings.description: Milliseconds every SMTP reply after the greeting is held back.

settings.name: tempfail
settings.description: When true, every RCPT TO is answered 451.

settings.name: auth_user
settings.description: The user name SMTP AUTH and IMAP LOGIN accept (fictional default).

settings.name: auth_password
settings.description: The password SMTP AUTH and IMAP LOGIN accept (fictional default); never logged, never in an event.
